title: Metric Namespace Root
brief: Our observability UI groups metric keys that a team has selected and shows the leading text they all start with as a header, so the rows below can show only the part that differs.
Implement sharedLeadingText(strs), where strs is the list of selected keys, and return the longest string that every key starts with.
